Wired into zig build test as status_json_regression. Verified against the live store (T516 now shows added + claim_count==1). No-neighbor regressions all green: managent-integrity, duty, ledger-board-seam, lock, done-two-phase, duplicate-dispatch, claim-lifecycle.
